meta_intent: Establish responsible engineering stewardship for a new or specified project, build an evidence-backed roadmap and autonomously complete only authorized scope.
question: Does the V0 prompt satisfactorily fulfill its proposed meta-intent in its intended context?
interpretation: The Project Stewardship Protocol explicitly requires repository reconnaissance, objective roadmap criteria, verified implementation, scope protection, truthfully measured progress, and conditional stopping. It covers the proposed meta-intent when initializing project stewardship. Adopting an already established project is better served by the distinct A prompt.
applicable_preconditions: Project identity and objective are established from its template or surrounding request.
Project evidence and necessary tools are accessible, or limitations are identified.
The task initializes stewardship without discarding accepted history or an existing roadmap.
failure_conditions: Never reset an already established project or overwrite accepted progress.
Unperformed code edits, tests and pushes must not be claimed verified.
The explicit conditional continuation contract forbids inventing work after completion.
source_text_evidence: continue if warranted, otherwise do nothing
